description: Fetch a published guide or bundle page, including Black Friday, Amazon bundle pages, under-$ guides, and GTA 6 gear. Returns the page URL, summary, and a capped list of already-published product links.

limit.description: Max matching guides to return (default 3, max 5).

query.description: Guide topic, slug, or URL, for example 'gifts for mom', 'grandma gift bundle', or 'black friday'.

name: get_guide
title: Open a gift guide
